items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And that's when Cap met up with Tom, with, uh, Kit Howard. Oh, he met up with so many, Kit Orr and, uh,

ctx.x: Yeah, and the big majority of people over here, they used to love to come over there. Well, Tom Albert come over there by my daddy. And, uh, Tom, he was a great guy. He did, he had himself a wonderful time over there. And, uh, then when Cap came over here, that's when Cap started staying there. But by Tom Albert and my daddy, they were good friends. And then when Cap was over here, Cap didn't have anywhere to stay, Tom Albert took him in. Didn't charge him anything. But Tom Albert had a little band over here…
He was in the middle of all of them, really.
